<section id="faq-block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84" class="faq-main">
    <h3>Public Forums</h3>
    <div id="faq-block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84" class="faq row">
    
    
                    <div class="wrap-1block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84 faq-wrapper">
            <input type="radio" id="tab-1block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84" name="tabs">
            <label for="tab-1block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84"><p>Guidelines and Key information to know  <span class="cross"></span></p></label>
            <div class="content"><p style="text-align: left;">The Council may hold a public forum prior to each ordinary meeting of the Council for the purpose of hearing oral submissions from members of the public on items of business to be considered at the meeting. Public forums may also be held prior to extraordinary Council meetings.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the Council through this form. Applications to speak at the public forum must be received by <strong><u>4:00pm – three (3) business days</u></strong> before the scheduled Council meeting date.</p>
<p><!-- /wp:paragraph --><!-- wp:paragraph --></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The applicant must identify the<strong> item of business on the agenda of the scheduled Council meeting</strong> the person wishes to speak on, and whether they wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</p>
<p>For full guidelines to the Public Forum, these can be found in the adopted <a href="https://upperlachlan.nsw.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Upper-Lachlan-Shire-18-June-2026-Resolution-84-26-Review-2028.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice </a></p>
<p> </p>
</div>
            </div>
                    <div class="wrap-2block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84 faq-wrapper">
            <input type="radio" id="tab-2block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84" name="tabs">
            <label for="tab-2block_f861f3997c0d23a72ff88125fc123c84"><p>Application to speak at Public Forum  <span class="cross"></span></p></label>
            <div class="content"><p>Applications to speak at the public forum must be received by <strong><u>4:00pm – three (3) business days</u></strong> before the scheduled Council meeting date.</p>
<p>Please download the application <a href="https://upperlachlan.nsw.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Public-Forum-Request-to-present-form-and-guidelines.pdf">form here</a> and return to <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#95d6fae0fbf6fcf9d5e0e5e5f0e7f9f4f6fdf9f4fbbbfbe6e2bbf2fae3bbf4e0"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="c487abb1aaa7ada884b1b4b4a1b6a8a5a7aca8a5aaeaaab7b3eaa3abb2eaa5b1">[email protected]</span> </a></p>
</div>
            </div>
            
    </div>
</section>

<script>
	function hide_alert_area() {
		jQuery('#header-alert').remove();
	}

	function show_hidden_search_desktop() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").show();

	}

	function show_hidden_search() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").show();
		jQuery(".hamburger").click();
	}

	function toggle_hidden_search() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").hide();

	}

	function toggle_hidden_mobile_search() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").show();
	}
	jQuery(document).ready(function() { 

		jQuery(".display-home-trigger").click(function() {
			var toShow = jQuery(this).attr('data-display');
			var link = jQuery(this).attr('data-link');
			var heading =  jQuery(this).attr('data-heading');
			var subheading =  jQuery(this).attr('data-subheading');
			jQuery(".display-home-trigger").removeClass('active');
			jQuery(this).addClass('active');

			jQuery('.display-home').hide();
			jQuery('.display-home.'+toShow).show(500);

			jQuery('#display-home-title').html(heading);
			jQuery('#display-home-description').html(subheading);
			jQuery(".display-home-link").attr("href", "/"+link+"/"); 
			
		});

		jQuery(".footer-sub-click").click(function() {
			var get_this = jQuery(this);
			var click = get_this.attr('data-click');
			if (click == 0) {
				get_this.find('.fa').removeClass('fa-chevron-down').addClass('fa-chevron-up');
				get_this.attr('data-click', 1);
				get_this.find('.hidden-footer-content').show();
			} else {
				get_this.find('.fa').removeClass('fa-chevron-up').addClass('fa-chevron-down');
				get_this.attr('data-click', 0);
				get_this.find('.hidden-footer-content').hide();
			}
		});
		jQuery(".hamburger-menu").click(function() {
			jQuery(".overlay").toggle();
		});

		jQuery(".shop-menu-link, .shop-menu-container").hover(function() {
			jQuery(".shop-menu-container, .overlay").show();
			jQuery(".search-menu-container").hide();
		}, function() {
			jQuery(".shop-menu-container, .overlay").hide();
		});

		jQuery(".search-menu-link").click(function() {
			jQuery(".search-menu-container, .overlay").show();
		});

		jQuery(".la-times").click(function() {
			jQuery("#keyword").val("");
			jQuery("#search-data").empty();
			jQuery(".search-menu-container, .overlay").hide();
		});
		jQuery(".cart-menu-link, .cart-add-container").hover(function() {
			jQuery("#cart-add-container").show();
		}, function() {
			jQuery("#cart-add-container").hide();
		});


	});
</script>

<script>
	function hide_alert_area() {
		jQuery('#header-alert').remove();
	}

	function show_hidden_search_desktop() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").show();

	}

	function show_hidden_search() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").show();
		jQuery(".hamburger").click();
	}

	function toggle_hidden_search() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").hide();

	}

	function toggle_hidden_mobile_search() {
		jQuery("#hidden-search-header").show();
	}
	jQuery(document).ready(function() { 

		jQuery(".display-home-trigger").click(function() {
			var toShow = jQuery(this).attr('data-display');
			var link = jQuery(this).attr('data-link');
			var heading =  jQuery(this).attr('data-heading');
			var subheading =  jQuery(this).attr('data-subheading');
			jQuery(".display-home-trigger").removeClass('active');
			jQuery(this).addClass('active');

			jQuery('.display-home').hide();
			jQuery('.display-home.'+toShow).show(500);

			jQuery('#display-home-title').html(heading);
			jQuery('#display-home-description').html(subheading);
			jQuery(".display-home-link").attr("href", "/"+link+"/"); 
			
		});

		jQuery(".footer-sub-click").click(function() {
			var get_this = jQuery(this);
			var click = get_this.attr('data-click');
			if (click == 0) {
				get_this.find('.fa').removeClass('fa-chevron-down').addClass('fa-chevron-up');
				get_this.attr('data-click', 1);
				get_this.find('.hidden-footer-content').show();
			} else {
				get_this.find('.fa').removeClass('fa-chevron-up').addClass('fa-chevron-down');
				get_this.attr('data-click', 0);
				get_this.find('.hidden-footer-content').hide();
			}
		});
		jQuery(".hamburger-menu").click(function() {
			jQuery(".overlay").toggle();
		});

		jQuery(".shop-menu-link, .shop-menu-container").hover(function() {
			jQuery(".shop-menu-container, .overlay").show();
			jQuery(".search-menu-container").hide();
		}, function() {
			jQuery(".shop-menu-container, .overlay").hide();
		});

		jQuery(".search-menu-link").click(function() {
			jQuery(".search-menu-container, .overlay").show();
		});

		jQuery(".la-times").click(function() {
			jQuery("#keyword").val("");
			jQuery("#search-data").empty();
			jQuery(".search-menu-container, .overlay").hide();
		});
		jQuery(".cart-menu-link, .cart-add-container").hover(function() {
			jQuery("#cart-add-container").show();
		}, function() {
			jQuery("#cart-add-container").hide();
		});


	});
</script>
